description: Closed Convex operation spans (Stripe/Resend webhooks, payment intents, workflow terminals) exported from actions via a scheduled best-effort OTLP call, plus provider and API counts from backend logs. Operational telemetry, not the payment ledger: amounts and IDs are never exported; Convex tables stay authoritative.

panels.title: Stripe deliveries by type and outcome
panels.description: One span per signature-verified delivery: `stripe.webhook <event type|_other> <processed|duplicate|retry_requested|rejected|failed>`. Unverified or throttled requests are not recorded; `_unverified failed` is a server fault before verification.

panels.title: Stripe webhook faults · range
panels.description: Deliveries answered 5xx because dispatch failed (status error). Retry-requested 503s for mismatches are counted separately.

panels.title: Stripe retry-requested · range
panels.description: 503 answers asking Stripe to redeliver (missing payment/dispute, customer mismatch).

panels.title: Stripe handler p95
panels.description: Webhook handling time inside Convex (verification + dispatch mutation).

panels.title: Stripe duplicates · range
panels.description: Idempotent redeliveries (already in stripeEventsProcessed).

panels.title: Payment intent outcomes
panels.description: payments.createPaymentIntent results: intent_created, complimentary, already_succeeded, lock_conflict <slot|animator|venue>, rejected <domain error tag, incl. declined card>, failed [closed Stripe fault code such as api_connection_error]. Rejections are normal customer outcomes, not faults.

panels.title: Lock conflict pressure
panels.description: Checkout attempts refused because another session holds the slot, animator or venue lock.

panels.title: Payment intent p95
panels.description: Action duration (auth, terms, pricing recompute, locks, Stripe call) per outcome.

panels.title: Payment intent faults · range
panels.description: Unclassified failures (status error). Known domain rejections are excluded.

panels.title: Lock conflicts · range
panels.description: All lock_conflict outcomes in the selected range.

panels.title: Workflow terminals
panels.description: workflow.<booking_confirmation|broadcast_send> <success|canceled|failed>, one span per committed onComplete.

panels.title: Workflow run duration p95
panels.description: Start → terminal duration. Booking confirmation includes step retries; human animator/venue confirmation gates happen outside the workflow and are not failures.

panels.title: Delivery events by type
panels.description: Resend webhook events for Kidays senders: delivered, bounced, complained, delivery_delayed, opened. Other projects on the shared account are skipped.

panels.title: Bounces + complaints · range
panels.description: Hard bounces and spam complaints processed.

panels.title: Providers (Convex action fetches, from backend logs)
Provider fetches by origin
panels.description: Convex action fetches per allowlisted provider origin (backend log counts). Other origins are counted only in aggregate.

targets.expr: _stream:{cluster="davidapps-cluster",k_namespace_name="kidays-fr",app="kidays-fr-convex-backend"} "Fetch to origin" | extract "Fetch to origin: <origin>, success: <success>, initial_response_time: <ttfb>, total_time: <total_time>," | filter origin:in("https://api.stripe.com","https://api.resend.com","https://places.googleapis.com","https://data.geopf.fr","https://accounts.google.com","https://oauth2.googleapis.com","https://challenges.cloudflare.com","https://plausible.davidapps.dev","https://e.gurt.ing") | stats by (_time:15m, origin) count() as fetches

panels.title: Failed provider fetches by origin
panels.description: Fetches the backend reports as success: false (network or transport failure).

targets.expr: _stream:{cluster="davidapps-cluster",k_namespace_name="kidays-fr",app="kidays-fr-convex-backend"} "Fetch to origin" | extract "Fetch to origin: <origin>, success: <success>, initial_response_time: <ttfb>, total_time: <total_time>," | filter origin:in("https://api.stripe.com","https://api.resend.com","https://places.googleapis.com","https://data.geopf.fr","https://accounts.google.com","https://oauth2.googleapis.com","https://challenges.cloudflare.com","https://plausible.davidapps.dev","https://e.gurt.ing") success:="false" | stats by (_time:15m, origin) count() as failures

panels.title: Provider fetch latency · range
panels.description: p50/p95 total fetch time per allowlisted origin.

targets.expr: _stream:{cluster="davidapps-cluster",k_namespace_name="kidays-fr",app="kidays-fr-convex-backend"} "Fetch to origin" | extract "Fetch to origin: <origin>, success: <success>, initial_response_time: <ttfb>, total_time: <total_time>," | filter origin:in("https://api.stripe.com","https://api.resend.com","https://places.googleapis.com","https://data.geopf.fr","https://accounts.google.com","https://oauth2.googleapis.com","https://challenges.cloudflare.com","https://plausible.davidapps.dev","https://e.gurt.ing") | stats by (origin) count() as fetches, quantile(0.5, total_time) as p50, quantile(0.95, total_time) as p95 | sort by (fetches desc)

panels.title: Fetches to other origins · range
panels.description: Action fetches to origins outside the provider allowlist (not broken down: hosts may be user-specific).

targets.expr: _stream:{cluster="davidapps-cluster",k_namespace_name="kidays-fr",app="kidays-fr-convex-backend"} "Fetch to origin" | extract "Fetch to origin: <origin>, success: <success>, initial_response_time: <ttfb>, total_time: <total_time>," | filter not origin:in("https://api.stripe.com","https://api.resend.com","https://places.googleapis.com","https://data.geopf.fr","https://accounts.google.com","https://oauth2.googleapis.com","https://challenges.cloudflare.com","https://plausible.davidapps.dev","https://e.gurt.ing") | stats count() as other_fetches

panels.title: Convex API calls by endpoint
panels.description: Convex backend access log: /api/query, /api/mutation, /api/action, /api/sync counts.

targets.expr: _stream:{cluster="davidapps-cluster",k_namespace_name="kidays-fr",app="kidays-fr-convex-backend"} _msg:~"convex-cloud-http" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> " | filter path:in("/api/query","/api/mutation","/api/action","/api/sync","/api/query_batch") | stats by (_time:15m, path) count() as calls

panels.title: Convex API 5xx
panels.description: Server errors on the Convex function endpoints.

targets.expr: _stream:{cluster="davidapps-cluster",k_namespace_name="kidays-fr",app="kidays-fr-convex-backend"} _msg:~"convex-cloud-http" | extract "\"<method> <path> HTTP/<_>\" <status> " | filter path:in("/api/query","/api/mutation","/api/action","/api/sync","/api/query_batch") | filter status:~"^5" | stats by (_time:15m, path) count() as errors

panels.title: Backend CPU
panels.description: CPU cores for the Convex backend pod.

panels.title: Backend memory
panels.description: Working-set memory for the Convex backend pod.

panels.title: Postgres connections
panels.description: CloudNativePG backends for the kidays-fr-postgres cluster.

panels.title: Function limit warnings · range
panels.description: Executions that hit a Convex limit (TooManyBytesRead, UserTimeout, …). Any value is a function to fix. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Query cache hit ratio · range
panels.description: Share of query executions answered from the backend's query cache. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Scheduler backlog
panels.description: Seconds the oldest due scheduled job has waited. Anything above a few seconds means the scheduler is behind. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Function errors · range
panels.description: Isolate executions that ended in an error, all function types. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Function execution p95 by type
panels.description: User-code execution time per query, mutation, action and HTTP action. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Function executions by type and status
panels.description: Executions per second through the function runner. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Runner queue wait p95
panels.description: Time a function waits for an isolate before it starts. Rising wait with flat execution time means the backend is saturated. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Commit latency p95
panels.description: Convex commit (database) and the underlying Postgres commit. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, status) (rate(convex_local_backend_database_commit_seconds_bucket{namespace="kidays-fr"}[$__rate_interval]))), "stage", "convex commit", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, status) (rate(convex_local_backend_postgres_commit_seconds_bucket{namespace="kidays-fr"}[$__rate_interval]))), "stage", "postgres commit", "", "")

panels.title: Postgres connection acquire p95
panels.description: Time to get a pooled Postgres connection. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Subscription invalidation lag p95
panels.description: Delay between a commit and the re-run of the subscriptions it invalidates, i.e. how stale live queries get. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: HTTP API p95 by endpoint
panels.description: Backend handling time per API endpoint, WebSocket sync excluded (long-lived). Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Isolate recreations by reason
panels.description: memory_carry_over and user_timeout are driven by our code; idle_timeout and max_lifetime are normal recycling. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: WebSocket (re)connects by reason
panels.description: Sync connections opened per hour. InitialConnect is new clients; the rest are reconnects that re-run every subscription. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Scheduled jobs and crons by result
panels.description: Scheduled function and cron outcomes per second; occ is an optimistic-concurrency retry. Source: the backend's own /metrics, scraped in-cluster through kidays-fr-convex-metrics (davidapps-cluster). Counters reset when the backend restarts.

panels.title: Effect span errors · range
panels.description: Effect service spans that ended in failure. Effect service spans exported once per mutation/action runtime (closed allowlist, no attributes). Queries export nothing, and a mutation that throws exports nothing, so errors here are action failures and handled mutation failures only.

panels.title: Effect calls by service method (top 15)
panels.description: Calls per second per service method. Effect service spans exported once per mutation/action runtime (closed allowlist, no attributes). Queries export nothing, and a mutation that throws exports nothing, so errors here are action failures and handled mutation failures only.

panels.title: Effect p95 by service method (top 15)
panels.description: p95 duration per service method. Mutation spans measure user-code time inside the transaction. Effect service spans exported once per mutation/action runtime (closed allowlist, no attributes). Queries export nothing, and a mutation that throws exports nothing, so errors here are action failures and handled mutation failures only.

panels.title: Effect errors by service method
panels.description: Failures per second per service method. Effect service spans exported once per mutation/action runtime (closed allowlist, no attributes). Queries export nothing, and a mutation that throws exports nothing, so errors here are action failures and handled mutation failures only.

panels.title: Slowest service methods · range
panels.description: p95 per service method over the selected range. Effect service spans exported once per mutation/action runtime (closed allowlist, no attributes). Queries export nothing, and a mutation that throws exports nothing, so errors here are action failures and handled mutation failures only.
